amount_minor.description: Total proposed contract value in this fictional experiment. It is not annual recurring revenue.

currency.description: The ISO currency code for amount_minor. GBP and USD amounts must not be added together without a declared conversion.

close_date.description: The expected closing date of the opportunity, not a guarantee that it will close.

stage.description: The accepted sales stage. Lead, qualified and proposal are open stages; won and lost are terminal. Permitted edits follow the declared transition map.

occurred.description: The date of the customer interaction. It differs from the time at which the record was accepted into the system.
